Column gutter
rule: 8dp between grid columns (implementation choice: m3.material.io states no gutter value)

title: Responsive column grid
rule: Grid with columns and margins per breakpoint

title: Minimum touch target 48x48dp
rule: Interactive elements are at least 48dp square

title: Text contrast 4.5:1
rule: Text and icons against their container reach 4.5:1 at the standard contrast level

title: Large text / UI contrast 3:1
rule: Large text, icons, input outlines and state indicators reach 3:1

title: Contrast level medium
rule: DynamicScheme contrastLevel 0.5 (m3.material.io names the levels but gives no numbers; the value comes from material-color-utilities)

title: Contrast level high
rule: DynamicScheme contrastLevel 1.0 (m3.material.io names the levels but gives no numbers; the value comes from material-color-utilities)

title: Honour prefers-contrast
rule: Hook only: switch to higher contrast on request (a CSS media query, not an M3 spec item)

title: Honour prefers-reduced-motion
rule: With reduced motion on: use subtle fades instead of slide/scale, no parallax or shape morphing (m3.material.io). This CSS only zeroes the short durations; transform-based effects are up to the app

title: State layer behaviour
rule: Hover/focus/pressed/dragged overlay on the content colour

title: Light theme
rule: Default; roles map to light tones

title: Dark theme
rule: Roles map to dark tones, by preference or data-theme

title: Surface + on-surface pairing
rule: Content uses the on-colour of its container
